results.title: Dow names Karen S Carter as new CEO July 2026
results.description: Dow announces leadership transition effective July 1, 2026, with Karen S. Carter as CEO and Jim Fitterling as executive chairman.
extra_snippets: Dow announces leadership transition effective July 1, 2026, with Karen S. Carter as CEO and Jim Fitterling as executive chairman.

Effective July 1, 2026, Karen S. Carter, a seasoned executive with more than three decades of experience at the company, will become chief executive officer, succeeding Jim Fitterling, who will transition to the role of executive chairman of the board. Richard Davis will continue to serve as Dow's independent lead director.

This move is part of Dow's broader Transform to Outperform strategy, which aims to simplify its operating model and deliver at least $2B in additional near-term earnings. Since becoming CEO in 2018 and board chairman in 2020, Fitterling has reshaped Dow into a more focused, resilient, and innovation-driven enterprise.

Under his leadership, Dow successfully spun out from DowDuPont, navigated macroeconomic and geopolitical challenges, and advanced sustainability ambitions. Fitterling emphasized higher-growth, consumer demand-led markets while fostering a culture centered on safety, performance, and inclusion. ... "Serving as CEO of Dow has been the privilege of a lifetime," Fitterling said.

As Chief Operating Officer, she has overseen business and operational performance company-wide, with responsibility for Dow's operating segments and key functional organizations, while strengthening customer engagement and accelerating innovation.

Previously, Carter served as President of Dow's Packaging & Specialty Plastics, the company's largest operating segment, where she led value growth through asset upgrades, capacity expansions and improved reliability, while advancing circular economy solutions in close partnership with customers and brand owners.

Our focus remains unwavering: delivering reliable and innovative solutions for our customers, and long-term value for our employees and our shareholders, while accelerating our transformation to set a new competitive standard for best-in-class performance. extra_snippets: Dow has appointed Karen S Carter as CEO effective July 2026, succeeding Jim Fitterling, who will become executive chairman. The transition comes amid a 4,500-job reduction and a broader cost and AI-led transformation strategy, signalling a sharper focus on operational efficiency, workforce restructuring, and execution in the company’s next growth phase.

These measures form part of Dow’s broader “Transform to Outperform” strategy, which targets at least $2 billion in near-term earnings growth. The company is also increasing its use of artificial intelligence to streamline operations, signalling a shift towards leaner, technology-enabled workforce models.

Richard Davis will continue as independent lead director, ensuring governance stability during the transition. Davis credited Fitterling with repositioning Dow following its separation from DowDuPont and navigating macroeconomic challenges, while expressing confidence in Carter’s ability to lead the next phase.

Carter brings over three decades of experience at Dow, most recently serving as chief operating officer. She has led enterprise-wide operations and previously headed the Packaging & Specialty Plastics business, driving growth through capacity expansion, asset upgrades and circular economy initiatives.
